acts: Give it something.
Pick one venture this month and carry it to its first result.
Plant one thing this week, a seed or a skill, and watch it grow.
Drop one project you no longer believe in.
Choose three things for this month and turn down the others.
Ask someone you respect to grade one piece of your work, and hear the score.
Say your doubt out loud the next time a plan is agreed too fast.
Stay with one hard feeling for ten minutes before you act on it.
Tend one plant or one friendship with no goal attached.
Bring one half-done job from last year to its end this month.
Hold a big choice for seven days and see if it still stands.
Send the rough draft before the clean one exists.
Try a new method on a familiar problem.
Cut one commitment this month that drains more than it gives.
Decide your stopping time before the work begins, and stop there.
Say your plan to a person who can refuse it.
Share one unfinished piece of work with three people this month.
Tell someone one story with no lesson in it.
Ask one person what they took from it, and listen to the end.
Keep one piece of news to yourself for a week.
Hold to one plan for a whole month.
